messages.content: I have been trying to access my billing history for the past week but the page keeps showing an error. I need to download invoices for my accounting records urgently.

Hi Alice, thank you for contacting us. I have taken ownership of your case and am currently investigating the billing history issue. I can see this is affecting your accounting workflow — I will prioritize this.

Checked the billing service logs — there is a database migration running that locked the billing_history table for user IDs in the 1000-2000 range. Alice's account falls in this range. Should resolve automatically by EOD.
Thank you for looking into this. I still cannot access the page as of this morning. Could you give me an ETA?
Hi Alice, I apologize for the delay. We are deploying a hotfix tonight. You should have full access by tomorrow morning. I will confirm once the deployment is complete.
After enabling 2FA on my account last Tuesday, I stopped receiving the verification codes on my phone. I have tried resetting it three times with no success.

Hello Alice, I am reviewing your 2FA issue. Could you please confirm: (1) Which phone number is registered for 2FA? (2) Have you recently changed your phone or phone number? (3) Are you checking SMS or an authenticator app?
I cancelled my subscription on July 20th and was told the refund would be processed within 5-7 business days. It has now been 10 business days and I still have not received my refund.

Hi Bob, I have investigated your refund case. Our payment processor shows the refund was initiated on July 22nd but appears to have been delayed by your bank's processing queue. I have escalated this with our finance team.
Finance confirmed the refund of $89.99 was reprocessed and will appear in Bob's account within 2-3 business days. Case resolved.

Great news Bob! Your refund of $89.99 has been reprocessed and should appear in your account within 2-3 business days. We apologize for the inconvenience and delay. Please let us know if you do not see it by August 10th.
